tools.name: browser_navigate
tools.description: Navigate to a URL. Returns markdown with Ran Playwright code + accessibility snapshot first span.

tools.name: browser_navigate_back
tools.description: Go back to the previous page.

tools.name: browser_navigate_forward
tools.description: Go forward to the next page.

tools.name: browser_snapshot
tools.description: Capture accessibility snapshot of the current page. The snapshot is divided into manageable spans (--span-size, default 2000 chars; configured to 5000 in Toolathlon) and only the first span is shown. Use browser_snapshot_navigate_* and browser_snapshot_search to access the rest. Each chunk semantics: snapshot is sliced sequentially into 0-indexed spans; each span is a contiguous slice of the YAML accessibility tree.

tools.name: browser_snapshot_navigate_to_span
tools.description: Navigate to a specific span (0-based index) of the latest snapshot.

tools.name: browser_snapshot_navigate_to_first_span
tools.description: Navigate to the first snapshot span.

tools.name: browser_snapshot_navigate_to_last_span
tools.description: Navigate to the last snapshot span.

tools.name: browser_snapshot_navigate_to_next_span
tools.description: Navigate to the next snapshot span (clamps at last).

tools.name: browser_snapshot_navigate_to_prev_span
tools.description: Navigate to the previous snapshot span (clamps at first).

tools.name: browser_snapshot_navigate_to_line
tools.description: Navigate to a specific global line number (1-based) in the snapshot, with surrounding context lines (default 3).

tools.name: browser_snapshot_search
tools.description: Search across all spans of the current snapshot using a regex. Returns span indices + global/in-span line numbers for each match.

tools.name: browser_click
tools.description: Perform click on a web page using element ref from snapshot.

tools.name: browser_hover
tools.description: Hover over an element on the page.

tools.name: browser_drag
tools.description: Drag-and-drop between two elements identified by ref.

tools.name: browser_type
tools.description: Type text into an editable element. Set submit:true to press Enter after.

tools.name: browser_select_option
tools.description: Select one or more options from a dropdown.

tools.name: browser_press_key
tools.description: Press a keyboard key (e.g., Enter, ArrowLeft).

tools.name: browser_wait_for
tools.description: Wait for either time (seconds), text to appear, or text to disappear.

tools.name: browser_evaluate
tools.description: Evaluate JS in the page (or on an element). Function source as string.

tools.name: browser_take_screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of viewport or specified element. With --image-responses=omit (Toolathlon default) returns text only and writes the file to --output-dir.

tools.name: browser_file_upload
tools.description: Upload one or more files (absolute paths).

tools.name: browser_handle_dialog
tools.description: Accept or dismiss the most recent dialog. promptText only used for prompt dialogs.

tools.name: browser_console_messages
tools.description: Return collected console messages from the page.

tools.name: browser_network_requests
tools.description: Return collected network requests.

tools.name: browser_resize
tools.description: Resize the browser viewport.

tools.name: browser_close
tools.description: Close the browser context/page.

tools.name: browser_install
tools.description: Install browser binaries if missing.

tools.name: browser_scroll_up
tools.description: Scroll up by amount px (default one viewport).

tools.name: browser_scroll_down
tools.description: Scroll down by amount px (default one viewport).

tools.name: browser_scroll_to_top
tools.description: Scroll to top of page.

tools.name: browser_scroll_to_bottom
tools.description: Scroll to bottom of page.

tools.name: browser_tab_list
tools.description: List all open tabs with indices and titles.

tools.name: browser_tab_new
tools.description: Open a new tab, optionally navigating to a URL.

tools.name: browser_tab_select
tools.description: Switch to the tab at the given index.

tools.name: browser_tab_close
tools.description: Close the tab at the given index, or current tab if omitted.
